summary: Frontend regression test after monolithic App.js split into modular files (context/AuthContext, components/{Sidebar,Layout,ProtectedRoute,Pagination,Spinner}, pages/{Login,Dashboard,Absensi,Siswa,Sejarah}, lib/{api,format}). All 8 requested flows PASS on preview URL with admin/admin123. Login → cookie set → /dashboard renders (hadir=3, sakit=1, ijin=1, pulang=1, laki=4). Dashboard: dashboard-loading spinner appears, kelas_list = ['Semua Kelas','6A','VIII','XI'], kelas filter refetches, gender+name filters work. Absensi: loading spinner shows, table renders 7 rows, pagination sizes exactly [5,10,50,100], info 'Hal 1 / 2 (7 data)', filter Status=Sakit → 'Hal 1 / 1 (1 data)', export/generate/refresh buttons enabled. Siswa: siswa-loading spinner shows, add button present, pagination sizes [5,10,50,100], search='a' → 'Hal 1 / 1 (6 data)'. Sejarah: sejarah-loading spinner shows, sejarah-table renders, Aksi filter works. Sidebar active link class 'nav-link nav-link-active' correctly applied. Logout: nav-logout opens logout-confirm modal; logout-cancel closes it; logout-confirm-yes redirects to /login. Mobile (390x844): mobile-menu-btn opens drawer, sidebar-backdrop click closes it. No console errors, no page errors, no regressions from the refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: Good refactor: file sizes are healthy (Absensi 403, Siswa 384, others <200). Files under the 700-line guideline.

AuthContext registers a global axios response interceptor that sets user=null on ANY 401 across the whole app. This is fine currently, but if you ever have a 401-returning endpoint that isn't auth-related (e.g., an optional resource), it would silently log the user out. Consider scoping by URL prefix.
AbsensiPage still passes { params: { tanggal: today } } with browser-local date; iter6 flagged this timezone drift risk — carried over unchanged (as expected for a pure refactor).
Sidebar.js embeds the logout modal inline; it re-renders whenever Layout state changes. Minor — no perceivable perf impact at this app size.

lib/api.js sets axios.defaults.withCredentials = true on the shared default instance (side-effect on module import). Works, but a dedicated axios.create() instance would be cleaner and avoid coupling with any 3rd-party code that also imports axios.
seed_data_creation: None. No new students or absensi rows were written during this run (all mutations were read-only filter/search/pagination interactions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is now modular: src/App.js is a slim router (60 lines), auth lives in src/context/AuthContext.js, all pages under src/pages/*.js, shared UI under src/components/*.js. New testids from this refactor: mobile-menu-btn (Layout topbar hamburger), sidebar-backdrop (drawer overlay), auth-checking / dashboard-loading / loading / siswa-loading / sejarah-loading (Spinner instances). All previously-verified testids preserved. Backend was not touched — regression suite in /app/backend/tests/ should still be green.
